study.name: Attention modulates a supramodal decision signal across choice domains
study.citation: Fernandez, K., Nunez, M. D., & Krajbich, I. Attention modulates a supramodal decision signal across choice domains. In preparation.

description: Food liking ratings from the value condition of an EEG + eye-tracking study; continuous slider stored in pixel units (1-870). Items are the lab's 100Foods set, mapped via a value-verified key derived from Smith & Krajbich (2021).
